gloss: to enshrine; to deify; to worship

definitions.explanation: To install and worship a deity at a shrine or sacred place.
To honor and pay respects to gods or ancestors.
To celebrate a deity through festival activities.

examples.japanese: この{神社|じんじゃ}には{天照大神|あまてらすおおみかみ}が{祭|まつ}られている。
examples.english: Amaterasu Omikami is enshrined at this shrine.

examples.japanese: {村|むら}の{人々|ひとびと}は{毎年|まいとし}この{神|かみ}を{祭|まつ}っている。
examples.english: The villagers hold a festival for this god every year.

notes:
{祭|まつ}る is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}).

ASPECT ({ている}):
The ている form typically indicates a continuing state ({祭|まつ}られている = 'is enshrined'). This is very common for describing which deity is worshipped at a shrine.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [deity/ancestor]を{祭|まつ}る (enshrine/worship ~)
- [location]に{祭|まつ}られている (is enshrined at ~)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {神|かみ}を{祭|まつ}る (enshrine a god)
- {先祖|せんぞ}を{祭|まつ}る (worship ancestors)
- 〜に{祭|まつ}られている (is enshrined at ~)

RELATED WORD:
{祭|まつ}り ({祭|まつ}り) means 'festival' and is the noun form related to this verb.
